name: [2026.1] Nose Down Depth Companion
description: Diagnostic companion to stock Nose Down by Kugler (3729673507), load after it for normal use. Adds read-only immersion, drag, engine and pitch-controller logging at up to 10 Hz with traceLogging enabled. Existing physics settings retained. Diagnostic-only operation without Nose Down is supported; see Docs/ENTRY-DIAGNOSTICS.md. Source and license: https://github.com/Landomatic/UboatMods/tree/main/mods/nose-down-depth-companion
author: Landomatic
